questions.stem: A student investigates respiration using germinating seeds in a sealed flask with a carbon dioxide absorber. The liquid in the attached manometer moves inward. What does this show?

options.text: The seeds are photosynthesising and producing oxygen
The seeds are respiring and consuming oxygen
The seeds are releasing carbon dioxide faster than using oxygen
The carbon dioxide absorber has stopped working

questions.explanation: The carbon dioxide absorber removes CO2 produced by the seeds, so only oxygen consumption affects the gas volume. As the seeds use up oxygen through aerobic respiration, the total gas volume decreases, causing the manometer liquid to move inward toward the flask.
